coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 3 of 9 ground-truth variable items (33%): the Llama-2-13B versus Llama-2-70B comparison, standardized prompt formatting broadly, and measurement of reasoning and instruction adherence.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Replaces the eight specified task environments with unrelated benchmarks and introduces token exposure and alignment as manipulated factors. Temperature is not fixed at 0 throughout. Identical task splits, the required detailed-outcome evaluation protocol, aggregated performance across the specified environments, and TLE/Invalid Format/Invalid Action breakdowns are missing. Prompt standardization also lacks the specified post-processing detail.
